create_dataset_get_dataset: create a dataset using get_dataset with train_transform, tokenizer, and args for SIMCLR, CLIP, or SLIP models
create_dataset_get_downstream_dataset: create a downstream dataset using get_downstream_dataset with catalog, name, is_train, and transform
create_dataset_ImageCaptionDatasetCLIP: create an ImageCaptionDatasetCLIP with dataset, root, metadata, transform, and tokenizer for CLIP-style training
create_dataset_ImageCaptionDatasetSLIP: create an ImageCaptionDatasetSLIP with dataset, root, metadata, transform, augment, and tokenizer for SLIP-style training
create_dataset_ImageCaptionDatasetSSL: create an ImageCaptionDatasetSSL with dataset, root, metadata, and augment for self-supervised learning
